20 世纪 60 年代，NASA 工程师 Stephen Papell 想在失重: In the 1960s, NASA engineer Stephen Papell developed an early ferrofluid while exploring how magnetic fields might move liquid fuel in weightlessness. Today ferrofluids also help cool loudspeakers and seal high-speed rotating shafts.
